style_when: the story is a single number, rule, gate or shift and restraint is the point — with no scene to photograph, the frame must still be a real assembly: a modular bay, an unlatched inspection gate, a rack of blades, an interlocking connector
prompt: Minimalist studio composition of a modular mechanical assembly resting on a weathered concrete surface. A central heavy anodized aluminum compute housing splitting into three distinct interlocking modular rack bays of varying heights. Positioned asymmetrically on the right third of the frame with generous negative space to the left. The engineered parts feature hard clean edges, matte surfaces, and frosted copper connectors. One strong directional key light throws long, deep cast shadows across the concrete. Muted industrial color palette, highly tactile materials. No bare geometry, no molded lettering.
negative_prompt: text, typography, letters, numbers, wordmarks, watermarks, logos, labels, ui, graphic overlays
rationale: This treatment perfectly captures the structural logic of a single system splitting into three distinct economic pathways, using tangible modular hardware to represent the market divergence without resorting to literal data centers.
